app.name: Match Point Art
app.tagline: Find it. Visit it. Leave your mark.

step1.title: Discover your city's art
step1.body: Murals, stencils and painted light boxes, all on one map.

step2.title: Visit and leave your mark
step2.body: Check in at each point and see who else has been there.

step3.title: Connect through art
step3.body: Every point tells a story and links the people who've passed through.
